# Amiga News — MorphOS retailer shipments

- Original title: Robin Hood for MorphOS
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.amiga-news.de/de/news/AN-2006-11-00129-DE.html)
- Author / publisher: RuneSoft press release supplied by Thomas Steiding; Amiga News
- Language / date: German; 2006-11-29
- Access: Short press-release text inspected through indexed text; direct article retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

RuneSoft announces that all retailer orders for the MorphOS version were dispatched the previous day, placing those shipments on 28 November 2006. The notice also points readers to the project website for a demo.

This supplies a more specific distribution milestone than a generic release-year listing. It describes the publisher’s reported shipment to resellers, not proof that every customer received a copy that day.
